column1: # THE LIVING ROSTER (16 October 2026). Who is living, recorded by name and slug with NO DATE.
# Every file in this repository is public, and the estate's standard is that a living person carries no
# date in any committed file. The rule itself is "born 80 years ago or less, no death recorded"
# (the kit's living_rule.py), and it needs a birth year to be applied. For a person whose year used to
# sit in a public working file, this roster is the explicit committed flag instead: the person is living,
# here is their town and country, and no year is held anywhere in this repository.
# A roster row is a CLAIM, and tools/check-living-standard.py checks it: the file must hold at least one
# row, no digit may appear in it, each person must appear in data/relations.tsv with the slug written here,
# and none may have a recorded death or a public-source citation anywhere in the data. When a person on this
# roster dies, delete the row and record the death; the build refuses to publish a roster person as living
# town is the town or city, never a street or an institution; country is the country.
